narration: You knot the scorched tag beneath the belfry clapper and give the square its tune with the last note bent deliberately flat. Heads turn. Two sleepers lean from separate windows; the desk keeper freezes; somewhere above, a floorboard answers. The trick is not making them hear you—it is making the true listener reveal that the mistake matters. Make a Charisma (Performance) check, DC 12.

payload.note: Mira ties the scorched O.A.W.—7 room tag beneath the alley belfry clapper as bait.

forecloses: immediate pursuit of the performer into Room Seven

success.narration: You repeat the flattened note. The square winces, but Room Seven answers with the correct pitch—once, sharply—from behind its closed shutter. A second figure across the square starts toward the boarding house, realizes you saw them, and turns away.

payload.what: When Mira deliberately played the shared tune wrong, the supposedly empty Room Seven answered with the correct final note.

nearMiss.narration: The wrong note draws a dozen unconscious corrections at once. You cannot isolate the first voice, but every correcting face turns toward the boarding house before its owner remembers not to. The trap reveals a shared direction, not a culprit.

fail.narration: The bent note sets the belfry tag rattling and the clapper answers too loudly. Irritated faces turn toward you, then away. Whatever listened from upstairs stays silent; the performer has time to move while the square blames the bard.

ruling.understoodAction: Reject the obvious pursuit, place the room tag on the alley belfry, and use an intentionally flawed performance as a public counter-trap.
ruling.ruling: The alternate approach is valid and does not advance Mira into Room Seven. Placing the tag is deterministic; isolating a meaningful reaction from the crowd requires Performance.
ruling.stakes: Success identifies a response from the supposedly empty room; a near miss reveals only collective orientation; failure makes noise without isolating the tune’s source.

outcomeBranches.nearMiss: the crowd reveals only a direction
outcomeBranches.fail: the signal is lost in the belfry noise
